sacred_clauses: Exclusions from Confidential Information; Survival of Confidentiality Obligations
risk_appetite: We accept non-material redlines (venue, governing law, notice mechanics, minor wording) to keep a deal moving, but hold firm on the two clause types named above and never accept a limitation-of-liability clause that reaches a confidentiality breach.
leverage: Collaborative — four of our six negotiated NDAs closed on our own paper and most changes were accepted without escalation; we lead from our standard form but do not force it through unchanged.
rounds: Typically two rounds of redlines before we escalate to outside counsel or walk; our own history shows most deals settle by the second or third version.
flexible_clauses: Governing law, dispute resolution venue, and standard of care — our history shows these move to a counterparty's preferred jurisdiction or phrasing without us treating it as a loss.
audience: Terse — reviewed by in-house counsel who already knows the standard form, not a first-time reader.
